contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP POSTVMVS PF AVG ; R/ COS IIII

Copper alloy with silver wash. Coin. Radiate of Postumus (260-269), CR suggests issue of Cologne mint, 267-268, Reece period 13, RIC volume 5 part 2 no. 287. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: IMP POSTVMVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Victory standing right holding wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: COS IIII. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin, citing Sear…
